environment.description: Flask application deployed on EC2 behind an AWS ALB with default configuration. The ALB performs TLS termination and forwards traffic to the application on port 8080. No WAF is attached. Security groups allow inbound HTTPS from 0.0.0.0/0 to the ALB. The LDAP server (OpenLDAP 2.4) is on the same VPC subnet with no query restrictions or access controls beyond bind authentication. Application is the only consumer of the LDAP service.

config.ldap_server: OpenLDAP 2.4, no per-query ACLs, anonymous read disabled but service account has full subtree read
config.network: ALB SG: 0.0.0.0/0:443 inbound; EC2 SG: ALB-SG:8080 inbound; LDAP SG: EC2-SG:389 inbound
